dialogues.name: Tutorial Intro
dialogues.title: MISSION BRIEF
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: SYSTEM BOOT... NEURAL DECK ONLINE.
Welcome, Infiltrator.
The world you knew is gone.
Neo-Gaia is a fractured civilisation where megacorporations
known as the APEX ELITES seized control of every critical
facility left standing after the collapse.
Power grids. Water treatment. Medical networks. All locked,
behind encrypted subnets accessible only to those with the
proper clearance codes. They have the access. We have nothing.
You were an engineer before the walls went up. You still know
the systems. You still know the protocols. And you are the
only one left who can break through.
Your mission:
Infiltrate the APEX facilities. Crack their subnet protocols.
Dismantle their infrastructure stage by stage until the world
belongs to the people once more.
This is not just survival.
This is reclamation.
The facility is waiting, Infiltrator.
Let's get you combat-ready.

dialogues.name: Tutorial Outro
dialogues.title: MISSION BRIEF
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: DESTINATION REACHED.
You are now ready to navigate your way through the world.
Initiating phase shift to the next world...

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Level 1 Intro
dialogues.title: WORLD BRIEF
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Welcome to Stage 1 Level 1.
This floor has four power-control levers tied to the local lights and critical equipment.
Each lever is unstable and must be repaired through IP wire routing.
Restore all four levers to fully reactivate this sector.
When all four are stable, the next-level door will unlock.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Level 2 Security Breach
dialogues.title: SECURITY BREACH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: LOCATION BREACHED. APEX security has detected our position.
Five exhausted wire repairs created a traceable pattern in the facility network.
We cannot continue from this location.
Falling back to Stage 1 Level 1. Rebuild the breach route and try again.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Level 1 Security Retreat
dialogues.title: GO DARK
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: APEX noticed our location and its response teams are closing in.
We have to hide in the previous sector until their trace loses our signal.
They now know the route we used to reach Level 2.
We have to go through Stage 1 Level 1 again and rebuild the breach from the beginning.
Move carefully. We cannot let them reacquire us.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Tutorial Opening
dialogues.title: WIRE PATCH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Welcome to your first live wire patch.
This is Lever 01 of 04 for Stage 1 Level 1.
Repairing each lever restores lights and equipment in this facility.
All four levers must be fixed to open the next-level door.
Match each full IP address on the left to the correct Class connector on the right.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Tutorial Success
dialogues.title: WIRE PATCH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Patch stable.
Good work. Lever 01 of 04 is now supplying power again.
Facility lights and equipment are recovering in this sector.
Continue to the next lever until all four are stabilized.
Once all four are fixed, the next-level door will open.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Tutorial Packets Shifted
dialogues.title: PACKET SHIFT
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Oh no!
APEX defense shifted the packet layout again.
Step back onto Lever 01 when you are ready.
We need this lever online before progressing to the remaining three.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Recovery Reset
dialogues.title: LEVEL INSTABILITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Oh no!
Too many packet errors tripped the APEX rollback circuit.
The rollback destabilized Lever 01 and cut power recovery progress.
Return to Lever 01 and repair it again.
After Lever 01 is stable, I will route you back to the failed lever node.
Remember: all four levers must stay stable to unlock the next-level door.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Harder Tutorial Opening
dialogues.title: ADAPTIVE SECURITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Congratulations, Hacker. Reaching this level means you have mastered the fundamentals of IP classification.
But the deeper we explore, the more aggressively APEX protects its network.
This patch chassis activates a random three to five IP Classes on every board.
A mismatch makes the rejected IP leads re-key themselves, while verified connections remain locked and unchanged.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Harder Tutorial Success
dialogues.title: ADAPTIVE SECURITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Adaptive re-key briefing complete.
Proceed to the strict challenge lever. Classify each changed lead again whenever APEX rejects a patch.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Harder Challenge Success
dialogues.title: STRICT SECURITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Excellent work.
Strict class-wire security is stabilized. Continue to the next quest node.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Terminal Alpha
dialogues.title: FIELD TERMINAL
dialogues.speaker: APEX NODE
slides: ACCESS DENIED.
The terminal is still offline while this floor's lever network is unstable.
Restore all four levers to recover full power and unlock deeper systems.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Junction Box Alpha
dialogues.title: JUNCTION BOX
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: A junction box hums behind the panel.
Its feed is linked to the four Level 1 repair levers.
Stabilizing all levers will restore full equipment output.

dialogues.name: Stage 4 Level 1 Intro
dialogues.title: WORLD BRIEF
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Stage 4 Level 1 is a damaged office subnet.
Five PCs are broadcasting corrupted address formulas across this map.
Follow the route beacon, catch the falling formula variables at each PC, and solve the missing IP addresses.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Opening
dialogues.title: NETWORK REPAIR
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: This PC is leaking corrupted subnet formula packets.
Formula variables are falling through five data lanes. Move the receptor to catch the variables needed by the active formula.
Network address uses the start of the block.
Broadcast address uses the end of the block.
Viable host IPs sit between network plus one and broadcast minus one.
After catching the correct variables, place them into the formula blanks and submit.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Quest 1 Correction
dialogues.title: REPAIR COACH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Pause the data stream.
This first PC is your calibration node. A wrong catch here means we review the subnet edge and keep the same PC active.
Find the block size from the CIDR mask, then identify which block contains the PC IP.
Network Address = Starting Network Address + (Block Size x (Subnet Number - 1)).
Broadcast Address = Base Network Address + (Block Size x Target Subnet) - 1.
Viable hosts run from Network Address + 1 through Broadcast Address - 1.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Rollback
dialogues.title: ROLLBACK CIRCUIT
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: APEX detected corrupted formula variables.
Their rollback circuit reopened PC 01.
Catch and place the correct formula variables at PC 01 again to prove the route table is stable.
After that, the beacon will return you to the PC where the failure happened.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Complete
dialogues.title: NETWORK REPAIR
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: All five PCs are routing cleanly.
Every corrupted IP address has been solved from captured formula variables.
Network address, broadcast address, and usable range traces are restored across the subnet.
